ticker_news.title: Where Will Palantir Stock Be in 5 Years?
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies has been one of the best-performing AI stocks, gaining 135% in 2025 with strong demand for its AI Platform across defense and commercial sectors. However, the article warns that its valuation is historically unsustainable, with a P/S ratio of 115 far exceeding even dot-com bubble peaks for Cisco, Microsoft, and Amazon. The analyst predicts Palantir faces a significant valuation correction over the next five years, making it a potentially risky investment despite solid business fundamentals.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco

ticker_news.title: Neumann Advisory Cuts Loose Pony AI Shares Worth $23.2 Million, According to Recent SEC Filing
ticker_news.description: Neumann Advisory Hong Kong Ltd completely exited its position in Pony AI Inc., selling 1,031,880 shares worth approximately $23.21 million on January 7, 2026. The fund's complete divestment signals a move away from the autonomous driving company, which remains unprofitable with modest revenue despite operating 1,000 robotaxis in major Chinese cities.
ticker_news.author: Jake Lerch

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100 Futures Drop— AZZ, Northrop Grumman, Immuneering In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Thursday with investors awaiting Supreme Court ruling on tariffs and December jobs reports. AZZ surged on strong earnings, Northrop Grumman jumped on defense spending proposals, while Immuneering tumbled on disappointing trial data and Phathom dropped following stock offering announcement. Constellation Brands rose on better-than-expected earnings.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra

SPY.title: How the AI Boom Connects to a 7.9% Dividend Story That Started in 1854
SPY.description: The article argues that the AI market is not in a bubble, citing moderating NVIDIA stock gains and valuations comparable to Costco. It recommends the Adams Diversified Equity Fund (ADX), a closed-end fund with a 7.9% yield and roots dating to 1854, as a dividend-focused way to benefit from continued AI growth while beating the S&P 500.
SPY.author: Michael Foster
